Zone of Truth **does not compel speech**, players explicitly told no intimidation/violence. Researcher went mad/controlling others per Cheet/Broadside and later guild finding, not objective physical possession proven |

| DEL-S1E12-005 | Bullywug warning and First Sons custody | Straw-hatted bullywug **actually escorts Boonefellow to road**, who was injured; **Faelan abducted** and **Norman missing** at then-current cutoff, not dead. Fish footprints at bullywug swamp village **compatible with Glepo Ma arriving**, but no played verbal warning delivery shown. Both First Sons members **later found alive** and Evelyn heals them. Frogman's own identity/role unresolved |

| DEL-S1E12-006 | Summoning ring/fragment relationship | Noble Hollow **summoning plate breaks when Faelan falls** as Marek knocked unconscious. Koh visually recognizes **same stone-metal geared fabrication** as S1E11 quarter disc. This **strengthens artifact relationship** yet no demonstrated physical fit, same individual device, mechanism operation, remaining fragments or magical repair. Remnant ritual's **city-threat claim** not observed fulfillment |

| DEL-S1E12-007 | Roper and piercer lifecycle | **Enormous roper described as birthing baby piercers from lower opening** in play, corroborating this dungeon's monster ecology. **One cultist swallowed by roper; survival is not shown**; Evelyn eventually destroys roper by **critical javelin in brood hole**. Not evidence every piercer extinguished (many crawl away), or roper was specifically conjured by ritual; collapsing ground **reveals it already in cave** |

| DEL-S1E12-008 | Aid and compassion | Broadside **helps subdue Solburn** rather than killing friend; **Krandal uses Command Drop twice** to release grappled friends, **Preserve Life first played** to restore himself to half and heal hostile-associated **Solburn by 9**, Solburn resumes ally attacks. Evelyn uses last 5 Lay on Hands **3 for Faelan, 2 Norman**; both return to consciousness. “Everyone lives” incorrect due swallowed cultist |

| DEL-S1E12-009 | Finale guild decisions and property | Selenar/Cassius **clear PCs**, plan Marek academy trial (no guilty verdict), Broadside/Solburn **cleared by guild** as influenced, Cheet **rehab planned** not shown, Big Bleeper Bloops subsequent fate unaddressed. Guild has **no supplemental cash** due war against northern vampires; **Krandal promised deed to old tower**, **not transferred in hand**. Bronze Ball not yet held |

| DEL-S1E12-010 | Snake Island hook and next intake | Short bearded patron brings **buckets of snakes and coins** and offers paid **Snake Island** assignment **at final cutoff**; no quest acceptance, departure or island visit. | DEL-S2E00-003 | Inspections and resource constraints | Board says **two researchers/silver guards were funded for forest ruin** nearly two months earlier, with no information supplied to Cassius.
